S1.source: text/mmc1__Table_S1_IVs.csv (converted from files/mmc1.xls, sheet 'Table S1 IVs')
S1.description: Exposure-side instruments for the 41 inflammatory factors. The converted table is in block layout (an exposure label row followed by its SNP rows, no per-row exposure column) and some SNPs occur in several blocks, so it cannot be filtered by label. This copy was generated mechanically from the converted CSV: the block label is written to an 'exposure' column, every cell string is copied verbatim, the trailing footnote marker 'a' (footnote: proxy SNP used as substitute for missing data) is moved from the SNP cell to 'proxy_footnote', and 'source_line' gives the line in the converted CSV. No outcome (endometriosis) per-SNP effects are reported anywhere.

WeiL2024JRI-1.notes: CCL2 = 'MCP1' block of Table S1 (exposure SNPs only; same 16 SNPs used for every endometriosis subtype). Claim estimate matches Table S3 row MCP1 -> Endometriosis (overall) (beta -0.138, OR 0.871). No per-SNP outcome effects in the paper, so the IVW estimate cannot be recomputed.
